scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build:apps
scripts.build:apps: npm run build --workspace @tarzan/api && npm run build --workspace @tarzan/web
scripts.build:packages: npm run build --workspace @tarzan/types && npm run build --workspace @tarzan/config
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @tarzan/api" "npm run dev --workspace @tarzan/web"
scripts.test: npm run build:packages && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:packages && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
